findings.current: The Emperor tilted his head, not quite grasping what I meant, then clicked his tongue.
findings.defect: Clicking his tongue replaces the Emperor’s lip-smacking gesture.
findings.rationale: 입맛을 다셨다 describes smacking one’s lips, not clicking one’s tongue.
findings.replacement: The Emperor tilted his head, not quite grasping what I meant, then smacked his lips.
findings.source: 내 말의 의미를 파악하지 못해 잠시 고개를 갸웃거린 황제가 입맛을 다셨다.

findings.current: The tightly fastened clasp came undone.
findings.defect: The cloak is held by a tied cord, not a clasp.
findings.rationale: 끈 is a cord, and 매어져 있던 specifies that it was tied.
findings.replacement: The tightly tied cord came loose.

findings.current: Then you’ll be all the more eager to accept this precious gift before I let go.
findings.defect: The draft changes the Emperor’s joke about his hand falling off from holding out the cloak into a suggestion that he will release it.
findings.rationale: 짐의 손이 떨어지기 전에 refers to his hand falling off, not to his letting go.
findings.replacement: Then you’ll be all the more eager to accept this precious gift before my hand falls off.
findings.source: 그럼 짐의 손이 떨어지기 전에, 더더욱 이 귀중한 선물을 받고 싶어질 테니.

findings.current: He’d thrown away his life without hesitation, and he didn’t regret that choice.
findings.defect: “Thrown away his life” implies that he lost it; the source says he staked it.
findings.rationale: 목숨을 판 돈으로 내던졌고 uses a gambling stake as its image. The Emperor risked his life rather than having already lost it.
findings.replacement: He’d wagered his life without hesitation, and he didn’t regret that choice.
findings.source: 거리낌 없이 자신의 목숨을 판 돈으로 내던졌고, 그 선택을 후회하진 않는다.

findings.current: “Success makes you a prince; failure makes you a traitor.”
findings.defect: The draft changes king or ruler to prince.
findings.rationale: 군왕 means king or sovereign, not prince; the contrast concerns who gets to rule and who is condemned as a rebel.
findings.replacement: “Success makes you a king; failure makes you a traitor.”
findings.source: 성공하면 군왕이요(成卽君王). 실패하면 역적이라(敗卽逆賊).

findings.current: Zhu Bao, who had to face the turmoil as heir to the Great Nation, had become someone who must never cry.
findings.defect: “Turmoil” obscures the war the heir must face.
findings.rationale: 전란 denotes war and its ravages, not merely general unrest.
findings.replacement: As heir to the Great Nation, Zhu Bao would have to face the coming war. He had become someone who must never cry.
findings.source: 대국의 후계자로서 전란과 맞서야 하는 주표는, 결코 울어서는 안 되는 사람이 되었다.

summary: Several passages alter a physical detail, a joke, or the Emperor’s meaning; the succession scene also softens an explicit reference to war.
